topics.title: Discussion about AI models and toolkits

claims.text: AI systems are not inherently intelligent; their complex abilities come from toolkits and example solutions.
Nobody needs AI to be truly intelligent because people themselves don't know how it works.
InstinctGPT comparison showed that a 3B model with a toolkit can gain a lot, but it cannot make up for the lack of basic model capabilities.
Older models were trained on everything without understanding the purpose, whereas modern models try to squeeze performance from fewer parameters and are sometimes fine‑tuned for specific tasks.

topics.title: Discussion about fees for diploma covers

claims.text: One participant reported being asked 650 UAH for a diploma cover.
Another participant said they paid 47 UAH.
A third participant mentioned a price of 30 UAH.
Someone suggested that covers are unnecessary because they become waste paper.
Another user noted that the cover includes a unique university emblem, making it somewhat valuable.
It was argued that no one will actually keep the cover.
A comment explained that the cover will be seen only a few times: when receiving the diploma, photographing it, and later when translating documents.
